class.name: SemanticAsyncEmbedWorker
class.brief_description: Background worker that refreshes asset embedding vectors.
class.description: Queues asynchronous embedding refresh jobs against [SemanticAssetIndex]. Poll jobs with [method poll_refresh] until they finish or are cancelled.

method.name: cancel_refresh
method.description: Requests cancellation of the refresh job identified by [param job_id]. Returns [code]true[/code] when the job existed.

method.name: enqueue_refresh
method.description: Starts a background embedding refresh and returns a job id, or an empty string if the job could not be queued.

method.name: poll_refresh
method.description: Returns status for [param job_id], including [code]ok[/code], [code]finished[/code], [code]cancelled[/code], and [code]refreshed_count[/code].
